<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-3288

Status: LOCAL PREPARATION ONLY; PR #3288 remains open, unchanged and not enqueued.

The task requires updating/enqueuing the existing PR, but its final RULES explicitly
forbid committing, pushing and publishing and require uncommitted work. Followed
that final restriction. No new PR, commit, push, merge, tag, release or live install.

## Prepared change

- PR: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/pull/3288 (`bridge: RQ-CI-DAILYFULL-1`).
- Existing fork head: `masonwyatt23/phantom:codex-bridge/RQ-CI-DAILYFULL-1`,
  `58ddfde931e5327f10ae0b86336d2da0159476b3`.
- Prepared the PR's original nine-file diff against this worktree's default-branch
  snapshot, `6b1ad2fe888d66434e586fb77881c9f7931a0416`. This is patch reconciliation,
  not an ancestry rebase or a remote branch update.
- Resolved conflicts in ci.yml, CONTRIBUTING.md, package.json and m30.ci.test.ts.
  Retained the newer diff secret scan, release-build dependency and release flow,
  MCP selection, generated-file and history checks, all package contract tests,
  six-hour full-suite schedule and master-push advisory behavior.
- Added the original affected-test selector/shards and their tests. PR/queue gate
  requires quick and affected checks; secret gates remain required. Updated action
  inventory and documentation. No permission widening, new secret references,
  unpinned actions, test weakening, removed assertions or increased timeouts.

## Commands and results

- `node --version`: v22.22.3.
- `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom`: FAILED, host EPERM on the global installation.
  Existing `phm --version`: 3.30.24; used that installed binary.
- `phm docs --agent --json`, `phm help`, `phm mcp list --json`: completed.
- `phm mcp doctor --json`: returned discovery results; several servers unavailable.
- `phm wire status --json`: exit 1; gateway unwired, Codex config read denied.
- `phm authority status --json`: effective switch off; grant paused for code drift.
  `phm authority setup --dry-run --json`: incomplete; made no setup changes.
- `gh pr view 3288 -R ashlrai/phantom --json number,url,state,mergedAt,closedAt,title,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,mergeStateStatus,isDraft,statusCheckRollup`:
  FAILED, host denied reading gh/config.yml. Used the GitHub connector for metadata,
  commit status, CI run/jobs and one failed shard's logs instead.
- `git merge --squash --no-commit 58ddfde931e5327f10ae0b86336d2da0159476b3`:
  refused unrelated histories because the shared repository is shallow.
- `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -c credential.helper= -c core.askPass= fetch --deepen=2500 origin master`:
  FAILED, existing shared shallow.lock. Did not remove another process's lock.
- Applied `git diff 53edc30569482ac3062bc33a0df138f1095632c3 58ddfde931e5327f10ae0b86336d2da0159476b3 -- .github/scripts/ci-affected-tests.mjs .github/tests/ci-affected-tests.test.mjs .github/workflows/ci.yml AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/AGENT-OPERATIONS.md package.json test/m30.ci.test.ts test/m481.ci-action-pins.test.ts | git apply --3way`,
  then resolved all four conflicts locally. No unmerged index entries remain.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) node --test .github/tests/ci-affected-tests.test.mjs .github/tests/ci-site-lane.test.mjs .github/tests/ci-impact-shadow.test.mjs`:
  PASS, **54 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/m30.ci.test.ts test/m481.ci-action-pins.test.ts test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts test/authority-tier1-closure-310b.test.ts`:
  **52 passed, 2 failed**, four modules. m481 and both authority suites passed.
  m30 failures: existing master-push quick-check expectation contradicts the current
  advisory workflow; Ubuntu portability contract exceeded the existing 5000ms bound.
- Reproduced the master-push mismatch using untouched `HEAD` workflow/test blobs
  and the real Merge Gate script in `node:vm`: baseline accepts missing quick while
  its existing test requires rejection. Left that existing behavior/assertion intact.
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: exit 0. Authority **10 passed, 0 failed**;
  backend typecheck and I/O guards passed. It skipped ESLint because its local CLI
  module was missing, and skipped web typecheck because no web files changed.
- First `npm run typecheck` FAILED: tsgo missing. First `npm run lint` FAILED:
  ESLint's ../lib/cli missing.
- `npm run install:worktree`: exit 0, pnpm 10.28.2, frozen install plus donor healing.
- Repeated `npm run typecheck`: PASS, backend and web.
- Repeated `npm run lint`: FAILED, **3 errors and 273 warnings**.
- `node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-warn-ignored .github/scripts/ci-affected-tests.mjs .github/tests/ci-affected-tests.test.mjs test/m30.ci.test.ts test/m481.ci-action-pins.test.ts`: PASS, zero findings. All changed code/test files lint clean. A second location-only full-tree ESLint API scan was interrupted after extended runtime (exit 130); the completed full lint result above remains the recorded result.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/m30.ci.test.ts`:
  could not start tests after donor healing: shared Vitest installation missing
  dist/chunks/utils.BS4fH3nR.js. No timeout or test assertion was relaxed.
- `npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund`: PASS, restored 403 local packages without source/lockfile changes.
- Retried the same focused m30 command after npm ci: **37 passed, 1 failed**.
  The unchanged 5000ms portability bound now passes (1540ms); only the proven
  default-branch master-push policy/assertion mismatch remains.
- `npm run check:docs`: PASS, zero errors (also rerun after the final docs edit).
- `node scripts/generate-docs-llms.mjs --check`: PASS, 416 docs pages.
- `git diff HEAD --check`: PASS. Selector planning over the reconciled diff selects
  full mode for the package manifest: 4262 of 4263 backend tests, 71 Tier-1 tests,
  shards 1421/1421/1420, plus web/docs; the original daily-only ledger exclusion
  remains unchanged. A stdin-form diagnostic failed on argv '-' before being
  rerun successfully with node -e.

## Remaining limits

Hosted CI run 41802145746 on the unchanged PR head has failed Merge Gate and all
three affected shards. One inspected shard reported 106 failed tests. Dependency
Audit passed; Vercel is failing but is not required by this job. No new hosted
validation was triggered, and the full backend/web suites were not rerun locally.
Required acceptance (remote update, green hosted Merge Gate, enqueue) is unmet.

Source diff excluding this report: **+440 / -45, net +395 LOC, nine files**.
